payload.name: Version History Is Chunked, Verified and Reversible
payload.description: Changes to files and container records are kept as de-duplicated chunk versions in one store. History is never pruned, every version rebuilds with a hash check, and a restore is deliberate and itself reversible.

principles.name: History is evidence
principles.description: A history that can be pruned, lost on restart or silently wrong is not a history.

principles.name: Store what changed
principles.description: A new version adds only the chunks that changed, so history costs far less than complete backups.

heuristics.condition: an in-memory index sits beside durable history
heuristics.action: make the index durable and reloaded at boot; ask whether rollback works after a cold restart

heuristics.condition: two stores record the same kind of change
heuristics.action: unify the writer and keep both views

decision_rules.name: One store for files and containers
decision_rules.condition: a file or container record is about to change
decision_rules.outcome: record it as a version in the shared history store under its scope; identical content adds no row

decision_rules.name: Rebuild by chunks and verify
decision_rules.outcome: concatenate its chunks and check every chunk and the whole by hash; a failed check is an error, never silently served

decision_rules.name: Baseline first
decision_rules.condition: a watcher first sees a file after a boot
decision_rules.outcome: record its current content when it differs from the newest version, so the first change has a before and changes made while the host was down are kept; a failed write forgets the baseline so the next poll retries

decision_rules.name: Never prune
decision_rules.outcome: rely on de-duplication; history is not capped or rotated, and reclaiming space is an explicit operator act

decision_rules.name: Restore is deliberate and reversible
decision_rules.outcome: treat it as an operator action on a session-protected route with a confirm phrase; record the current state first as a pre-restore version; append an audit row; a version captured from the raw bytes of an unparseable record is returned as an error with the bytes still readable

requires.name: file_history
requires.purpose: list the recorded versions of an item before restoring

decision_rules.name: Import old stores without deleting
decision_rules.condition: an earlier snapshot store is migrated
decision_rules.outcome: import idempotently, keep the originals, and write the completion marker only after a full success so a failure retries on the next boot

decision_rules.name: Erasure reaches history
decision_rules.outcome: include history objects in the erasure plan; chunks shared by several versions need reference-aware removal; record this as open until it is built
